market_outlook.short_term: Equities face headwinds from 20-year high yields and $103+ oil, but Iran-Hormuz deal hopes and US-China truce extension provide floor. Expect range-bound trading with sector rotation from growth to value/energy. Oracle and Nike are near-term drags. Microsoft Copilot launch may spark tech volatility. Dollar strength pressures EM and international equities.
market_outlook.long_term: 5% bond regime structurally compresses equity multiples, favoring cash-generative, low-duration businesses. AI capex cycle (Microsoft, Nvidia, AMD, SK Hynix) supports 12-18 month tech earnings. Grid modernization and defense spending provide secular tailwinds. Consumer bifurcation persists. US-China truce, if extended, supports global growth; expiration risks a sharp repricing. Great wealth transfer ($10T+ by 2030) drives long-term asset allocation shifts.
